distance_note: PLACEHOLDER — calibrate per-leg distances against a Tolkien atlas before locking. Totals ~1,779 mi per the classic fan Walk-to-Mordor accounting.

beats.arrival: The road goes ever on. Your first steps out of Hobbiton.
beats.departure: A ferry across the Brandywine, and the Shire is behind you.

beats.arrival: The trees are watching. Fog on the map; keep to the path.
beats.departure: Out of the downs with a song in your heart and a chill in your bones.

beats.arrival: A warm inn, a cold drink. First inn bonus: rest here.
beats.departure: Strider joins the party. The wilds ahead.

beats.arrival: The climb begins — incline bonus country.

beats.departure: The Ford of Bruinen behind you — the sanctuary ahead.

beats.arrival: The doors close. Drums in the deep.
beats.departure: Over the Bridge of Khazad-dûm — sprint beat. Daylight again.

beats.arrival: Golden wood. The mirror shows how far you've walked.
beats.departure: Gifts from Galadriel. The river waits.

beats.arrival: Steady water, steady miles. Endurance leg.
beats.departure: The falls roar ahead. The fellowship breaks.

beats.arrival: Choose your companion perk for the final stretch.
beats.departure: Two small figures, one vast wilderness.

beats.arrival: Don't follow the lights. Steady pace, no stops.
beats.departure: The marshes release you. The gate looms.

beats.arrival: The Eye is watching. Every march here earns bonus XP.
beats.departure: Ash and fire. One last climb.

beats.arrival: The final mile — best walked in one march.
beats.departure: It is done. Credits: every mile, every day. Now walk home.
